columns.statusTip: "Pending" — a new request. "Approved, awaiting setup" — the admin allowed it, but the client hasn't been created/verified yet (for WireGuard/AmneziaWG the panel usually creates it automatically; for OpenVPN/IKEv2 — manually on the provider page). "Granted" — the user can already download the config.

confirm.delete: Remove the denied request {{username}} → "{{label}}" from the list?
confirm.clearDenied: Remove all denied requests ({{count}})? Pending, approved, and granted requests are not affected.

messages.approveSuccess: Processed — see status in the table (some provider types require manual client setup on the provider page)
